headline:
Fullscreen
Live Chat
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE high-end Chrome extension listing promo exactly 1760 x 1120 pixels, 11:7 landscape aspect ratio. This is a fullscreen esports broadcast meets YouTube native live chat concept; do not make a gaming hardware advertisement. Huge white geometric sans headline at TOP LEFT: "Fullscreen" on first line and "Live Chat" on second line. Exact spelling Fullscreen as ONE WORD. The two lines dominate left top quadrant, legible at 440x280. Add a narrow vivid red vertical rule left of the headlines. Overall charcoal/white/red, sophisticated, no purple neon.
The almost edge-to-edge wide video field behind headlines shows ORIGINAL stylized esports aerial arena gameplay: red versus pale-blue abstract glider ships speeding above a geometric stadium, futuristic team sport with no recognizable game IP and no real people. Dynamic stream energy, tiny tasteful red LIVE dot/tag in upper corner but no viewer counts or status claims. Keep video dark enough behind headline for strong contrast.
On the RIGHT INSIDE video, a single dark native YouTube live chat pane, about 32% tile width, straight-on perfectly readable UI, modest 8px corners. Use the supplied reference ONLY as structural style reference for REAL native chat. Near-black #0f0f0f surface, header "Top chat" with down chevron and three vertical dots. Exactly seven compact flat text rows, each a SMALL circular avatar then muted gray @handle followed directly by WHITE short message inline ON THE SAME LINE (some wrap naturally). Entirely fictional UI sample rows such as @jamie What a save!, @lee So close, @atlas That was clean, @mia gg, @oliver One more round, @skye LET'S GO 🔥, @rei Nice play!. The panel must read like actual YouTube chat, not speech bubbles, not Discord or Twitch. No per-message cards or colored bubble backgrounds. Make letters crisp and message sizes compact, avatar disks tiny 24px relative to whole1760canvas. Footer: ownavatar, plain underlined "Chat..." input, smiley, small outlined paper-plane/send triangle. No huge rounded textbox, no second panel.
Use no existing game identity or creator likeness. Do NOT reuse source video, streamer, usernames, comments, or branding from reference. No real logos, endorsement, browser chrome, desktop monitor, keyboard, hardware, gamer room, giant floating speech symbols, subscriber cards or donation cards. Image is an original promotional illustration, not a claimed real screenshot.
conceptNote: 架空のアリーナ配信を全画面に広げ、右上にコンパクトなチャットを重ねる。
